column1: # Facts are canonical equivalence classes, expressed only as scalar values.
# Recipes were selected mechanically in scalar-vector lexicographic order.
# A candidate column must pass the production root-prefilter eligibility rules:
# it is present in every expansion, is not entirely UTF-8 structural leads, and
# a wide set spans at most eight high nibbles. Columns are ranked by production's
# (structural leads, frozen byte-frequency score, reverse offset) tuple. For a
# requested union cardinality, retain the first class that grows the union
# without exceeding the target and retain a recipe only when production selects
# the requested column. No character names or measured timings participate.
